title: Congruence mod m is preserved by multiplying on the right
statement: For every natural m and naturals a, b, c: if a is congruent to b modulo m, then a*c is congruent to b*c modulo m.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.mod_eq_mul_right : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : AxNat.modEq x0 x1 x2) -> AxNat.modEq x0 (AxNat.mul x1 x3) (AxNat.mul x2 x3))))))

evidence.supports: Nat.mod_eq_mul_right is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- Nat.mod_eq_mul_right 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.mod_eq_mul_right[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
